1) 用 SELECT * FROM V$RECOVERY_FILE_DEST: 1) Run SELECT * FROM V$RECOVERY_FILE_DEST to check the FRA quota and used space; 2) Use RMAN's crosscheck archivelog all; delete expired archivelog all; to clear already-backed-up archives; 3) Confirm the archive backup job is running — a pile-up of archives is usually caused by failed backups; 4) Longer term, raise db_recovery_file_dest_size or move the archive destination to larger storage.
1) 用 SELECT COUNT(*) FROM V$PROCESS 与 SH: 1) Compare SELECT COUNT(*) FROM V$PROCESS against SHOW PARAMETER processes to see the current level versus the limit; 2) Run SELECT machine, program, COUNT(*) FROM V$SESSION GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC to find the application with an abnormal connection count; 3) Tell business growth apart from an application connection pool leak (many INACTIVE sessions piling up); 4) As an emergency measure raise the processes parameter (requires an instance restart); for the root cause, cap the application connection pool.
1) 用 SELECT sid, serial#, sql_id, event,: 1) Run SELECT sid, serial#, sql_id, event, seconds_in_wait FROM V$SESSION WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND type='USER' ORDER BY seconds_in_wait DESC to see what the active sessions are waiting on; 2) If the wait events cluster on one type (such as enq: TX - row lock contention) there is lock contention — follow blocking_session to the source; 3) Use the sql_id against V$SQL to find the slow statement, and ALTER SYSTEM KILL SESSION to stop the bleeding if needed; 4) Once located, add indexes or rewrite the SQL, and check upstream for a traffic spike.
1) 用 SELECT tablespace_name, bytes/1024/: 1) Use SELECT tablespace_name, bytes/1024/1024 mb FROM DBA_DATA_FILES together with DBA_FREE_SPACE to identify the tablespace and whether the data file has reached its maximum; 2) Expand it: ALTER DATABASE DATAFILE '<path>' RESIZE <larger value>, or ADD DATAFILE; 3) Check whether large tables or historical data can be archived and deleted — after deletion you still need shrink or move to actually release space; 4) Check whether the data file has AUTOEXTEND enabled and what its MAXSIZE is.
1) 登录主机确认 pmon 进程与监听器状态（ps -ef | grep pm: 1) Log in to the host and check the pmon process and listener state (ps -ef | grep pmon, lsnrctl status); 2) If they are alive, connect by hand with sqlplus to tell a hung instance from a listener or account problem; 3) If not running, read the tail of alert_<SID>.log to identify the cause (ORA-00600, full FRA, full disk) before starting it; 4) If Data Guard is in place, immediately assess whether to fail over.
Oracle 进程数超过 500，接近 processes 参数上限时新连接会被: Oracle process count is above 500; as it approaches the processes parameter limit, new connections are rejected with ORA-00020.
Oracle: 监控数据采集失败，可能已经挂了: Oracle: metric collection failed, instance may be down
归档日志数量偏多，归档目录（FRA）有被写满的风险。FRA 写满后 Oracle: Archive logs are piling up and the flash recovery area (FRA) risks filling up. Once the FRA is full, Oracle suspends every write transaction — a classic self-inflicted outage.
活跃会话数超过 100，说明大量 SQL 正在并发执行且没能及时返回，再涨会耗尽: Active sessions exceed 100, which means a lot of SQL is executing concurrently without returning; further growth will exhaust the process count and drag the instance down.
表空间使用率超过 95%，写满后所有涉及该表空间的 INSERT/UPDATE: Tablespace utilization is above 95%; once full, every INSERT/UPDATE touching that tablespace fails with ORA-01653.
采集端已连不上 Oracle，实例可能已崩溃或网络不通，依赖该库的业务全部不可用: The collector can no longer reach Oracle; the instance may have crashed or the network may be down, and every workload depending on it is unavailable.
